focus: Canonicalize the shared actor/HUD sprite-record buffer and its VDP submission count.
contracts: The builders use 0x00FF729A as a four-word-per-record output cursor for X, sprite attribute, tile, and Y words.
Both builders append the four-word 1/0/0/1 terminator record before publishing the record count.
Render_SubmitPlayerSprites reads the count word at 0x00FFEFEC and streams two longwords per record from 0x00FF729A to VDP data, with a 0x80-count guard.
conclusion: The anonymous renderer addresses are a shared VDP sprite-record buffer base and its published record count.
